title: behold-graph/1
description: A behold graph as flat node and edge lists (behold#1066). Field names follow Grafana's node graph panel: a node has id, title, subtitle, mainstat, secondarystat, color and detail__* fields, and an edge has id, source and target, so the panel reads the lists with no transform. Every edge's source and target is the id of a node in the same document. No field holds an absolute path: files are relative to the repository root. Within behold-graph/1 fields are only ever added, and a reader ignores the fields it does not know. A change a reader could not ignore is behold-graph/2, which a behold-graph/1 reader refuses.

schema.description: The document's version. A reader refuses one it does not know.

generator.description: The behold that wrote the document and the chant that read the graph.

dir.description: The directory read, relative to the repository root. '.' is the root.

rev.description: The revision the graph was read at, when it was not read from the working tree.

cut.description: Which part of the graph the document holds. 'whole' is every card the view draws; a cut such as 'around' or 'changed' carries its parameters beside kind.

layout.description: Positions a host can draw without laying the graph out again.

id.description: The graph IR's node id, unique in the document.

subtitle.description: The tool that declares it: terraform, kubernetes, helm, choudoufu, or the chant lexicon.

box.description: The id of the innermost group the card is drawn in.

file.description: The declaring file, relative to the repository root. Absent when behold cannot place it there.

seed.description: In an 'around' cut, true on the cards the cut was asked for.

change.description: What a plan would do to it (create, update, replace, delete), when a plan was read and it changes.

stackOf.description: On a stacked card, the ids of the cards it stands for.

detail__member.description: The workspace member it belongs to.

detail__root.description: The Terraform root that applies it.

detail__namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace it lives in.

detail__release.description: The Helm release that installs it.

attrs.description: The graph IR's attributes. 'source' is present only when it was asked for.

source.description: The id of the node holding the reference.

target.description: The id of the node it names.

kind.description: The graph IR's edge kind: ref, needs, calls, triggers, includes, extends, or one added later.

inferred.description: True when behold or chant joined the two rather than a reader stating it.

rule.description: On an inferred edge, the join that drew it: behold:<pass>, or chant's catalog rule.

via.description: The consumer-side attribute the reference flows through.

kind.description: stack (a workspace member or a Terraform root), wave, pipeline, container, or one added later.

parent.description: The group this one is drawn inside.
